llm.summary: This is a plain Markdown real-estate compliance checklist with no code execution, persistence, credential access, or hidden data handling.

dimensions.detail: The skill only supplies advisory checklist content; it does not request local file access, network access, account access, mutation authority, or background workers.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains a single Markdown skill file and no install scripts, dependencies, executable files, or tool-wrapping behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The activation language covers broad transaction stages such as taking a listing and presenting offers, but the text consistently frames those triggers around compliance gates rather than unrelated authority or automation.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, memory writes, privilege escalation, credential/session use, or automatic remote retrieval is instructed. External links are present as references/marketing, not as executable payload instructions.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifact coherently provides checklist guidance for agency disclosure, fair-housing advertising, property disclosures, deadlines, and earnest-money handling in real-estate transactions.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, treat this as a compliance checklist aid rather than legal advice. It may activate for general real-estate transaction workflows, so users should apply it when disclosure, fair-housing, deadline, or brokerage-rule checks are relevant and still verify current federal, state, MLS, and brokerage requirements.
